title: ENDEX: EHR Downtime — Restore Without an All-Clear

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is now 09:40 on Tuesday, March 3, 2026. The hospital remains on paper. The clean-room build and credential reset are in progress. The EHR database restore has not begun. The forensic team is still validating the cloud copy. The breach assessment remains open. No patient data has been confirmed as safe. The three pre-live checks—allergy and high-alert medication data, pump drug libraries, and barcode scanning—have not been completed. The ISO has not signed off on clinical use. The ED remains on diversion. This exercise concludes.
finalState: The hospital is still on paper charting.
The clean-room EHR build and credential reset are underway.
The EHR restore has not started.
The HIPAA breach assessment is open and not closed.
The three pre-live verification checks have not been completed.
The ISO has not signed off on clinical use.
The ED remains on diversion for ambulances.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: How did the team balance patient safety with the need to avoid a premature all-clear?
What was the impact of not having a verified clean backup when the vendor insisted on a rebuilt environment?
How did the public statement in I-21 affect trust, and what would have changed if it had been delayed or revised?
How did the team manage the staffing crisis in the downtime, and what long-term impacts might it have on retention?
What gaps were revealed in the Downtime Procedures Annex (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026) or the Cyber Incident Response Plan (ORRMC-CIRP-2026)?
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect all ICS 201 forms and evaluator sheets before the break. The after action report must include findings from C2 and C5 on hot wash requirements and corrective actions.

instructorNote: This is the final inject. All roles must now transition to the hot wash. No further events occur.
